profile.synopsis_title: Tender Synopsis – RAMP / Brand DL Programme (VDP & RBSM)
profile.topic_one_line: Agency to organise 4 Vendor Development Programmes and 3 Reverse Buyer-Seller Meets for Delhi MSMEs under the RAMP scheme
profile.authority: Delhi State Industrial & Infrastructure Development Corporation Ltd. (DSIIDC)
profile.parent_body: Govt. of NCT of Delhi undertaking; nodal agency for RAMP (Ministry of MSME, World Bank supported)
profile.location: NCT of Delhi (bidder must be located in Delhi during execution)
profile.relevance_note: Event management, branding and outreach work – fits the Media / campaigns vertical.

key_facts_table: Delhi State Industrial & Infrastructure Development Corporation Ltd. (DSIIDC), GNCT of Delhi
Selection of Agency for Vendor Development Programme (VDP) & Reverse Buyer-Seller Meet (RBSM) under RAMP Programme (Brand DL Initiative)
Online only – Delhi Govt e-Procurement Portal

rows: 21.08.2026, 12:00 PM – DSIIDC HQ, N-Block, Connaught Circle

items.text: Single legal entity registered in India (Companies Act, LLP Act, Societies Registration Act or Indian Trusts Act).
Minimum **5 years'** existence and operation in India.
++Minimum average annual turnover of **₹8 Crore** in the last 3 financial years (latest FY 2024-25).++
Profitable in each of the last **3 financial years**.
==Completed, within the last 3 years, a **large-format corporate event of ₹1 Crore or above**.==
Not blacklisted by any Central/State Government Department/Agency.
Documents: incorporation, MoA/AoA, PAN, GST, CA certificates (UDIN), audited financials, work orders/completion certificates, declarations, Power of Attorney.

rows: Average annual turnover (₹8–10 Cr: 5 | ₹10–12 Cr: 10 | >₹12 Cr: 20)
Years of existence (5–7 yrs: 5 | 7–9 yrs: 7 | 10+ yrs: 10)
Govt/PSU mass-gathering events ≥₹1 Cr each, with MSME/corporate participation (1–4+ projects)
Govt/PSU promotional events, exhibitions, buyer-seller meets (1–3+ projects)

items.text: Mobilise **300 MSMEs** per VDP; engage **at least 50 large buyers** (PSUs, OEMs, anchor companies) per event.
Mandatorily onboard an industry chamber (FICCI / CII / ASSOCHAM) – within project cost.
B2B matchmaking, awareness sessions, branding and social-media promotion (DSIIDC approval needed).
Mobilise **500 export-oriented MSMEs** per RBSM; **at least 70 international buyers** per event.
Coordinate with trade bodies, missions and export agencies; facilitate MoUs/partnerships.

blocks.text: Venue, theme gates, 10×10 ft stalls per MSME, lighting, sound, security (DFMD, X-ray, CCTV), fire & medical, power back-up, toilets, parking, meals for media/staff, 2 photographers + 2 videographers, and all permissions (Police/Fire) at the agency's cost.
**Targets:** 4 VDPs + 3 RBSMs = **2,700 MSME participants**; KPI of **>75% positive feedback**.

items.text: ==**PBG: 3% of contract value**, within **15 days of LOA**, valid 120 days beyond completion.==
Payment: **40%** against 4 VDPs (10% each) + **60%** against 3 RBSMs (20% each); released within 10 days of invoice.
Completion of all activities by **28.02.2027**; contract valid up to **31.03.2027** (extendable 1 year by mutual consent).
Delay penalty: **0.5% of delayed milestone per week**, maximum **10% of work-order value**.
Work to start within **10 working days** of work order; all sponsorship revenue belongs to DSIIDC.
Persistent non-performance may lead to forfeiture of PBG/security and termination.

summary: DSIIDC invites bids for an agency to run 4 Vendor Development Programmes and 3 Reverse Buyer-Seller Meets (about 2,700 MSMEs) under RAMP, estimated at ₹4.00 Crore. Bids close 29.08.2026, 6:00 PM, with an EMD of ₹8,00,000 and QCBS 70:30 selection. Key disqualifiers: ₹8 Crore average turnover, profitability in all 3 years, a ₹1 Crore+ large-format event in the last 3 years, and no consortium.

key_facts.quote: A minimum qualifying score 70 out of 100
minimum average annual turnover of INR 8 Cr in the last three (3) financial years

key_facts.value: Large-format corporate event of ₹1 Crore or above in last 3 years
key_facts.quote: completed a large-format corporate events with a value of INR 1 Cr and above
equivalent to 3% of the contract value
within 15 days of receiving the Letter of Acceptance (LOA)
0.5% of the delayed milestone (or item in default, as applicable) payment per week of delay subject to a maximum of 10%
The Contract shall remain valid up to 31st March 2027

Turnover years differ: eligibility says last 3 FYs 'latest being FY 2024-25' (p.22) but the technical scoring asks for FY 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 (p.23). Clarify which set to submit.
RFP refers to eligibility/scoring as 'Section 8.1/8.2' (p.10) but they appear as Clause 7.1/7.2 – numbering error in the RFP.
